destinations.name: Lençóis Maranhenses
destinations.shortDescription: A vast landscape of white dunes and seasonal turquoise lagoons that transform with the rhythm of the rains.
destinations.overview: Lençóis Maranhenses National Park is a striking coastal landscape of rolling white sand dunes interrupted by freshwater lagoons. The lagoons form during the rainy season and create a remarkable contrast between sand, water and sky.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Despite its extraordinary scenery, the park sees far fewer international visitors than Brazil's famous beaches or Iguaçu Falls, and its vast landscape and small gateway villages offer experiences far removed from conventional resort tourism.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Fly to São Luís (SLZ), then transfer to Barreirinhas or Santo Amaro

experiences.title: Lagoon hopping across the dunes
experiences.description: Explore the dune landscape with a local guide and swim in seasonal freshwater lagoons.

experiences.title: Sunset over the sand sea
experiences.description: Walk across the dunes during late afternoon and watch the shadows stretch across the landscape.

experiences.title: Explore Atins village
experiences.description: Stay in a small coastal village near the park and experience its relaxed atmosphere.

destinations.name: Lake Bohinj
destinations.shortDescription: A peaceful alpine lake surrounded by forests, mountain peaks and traditional Slovenian villages.
destinations.overview: Lake Bohinj lies within the Julian Alps and forms part of Triglav National Park. Its clear waters, surrounding mountains and quieter atmosphere offer an alternative to Slovenia's more heavily visited Lake Bled.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Bohinj retains a more nature-focused and relaxed atmosphere, with opportunities to explore the lake, mountain trails and nearby villages.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Bus from Ljubljana to Bohinj or Bohinjska Bistrica

experiences.title: Paddle across Lake Bohinj
experiences.description: Kayak or paddleboard across the lake while taking in views of the Julian Alps.

experiences.title: Hike to Savica Waterfall
experiences.description: Follow a woodland trail and staircase to one of the region's best-known waterfalls.

experiences.title: Discover alpine village life
experiences.description: Explore traditional villages around the lake, local architecture and small family-run food businesses.

destinations.name: Narangala
destinations.shortDescription: A dramatic mountain viewpoint where rolling grasslands and misty valleys meet spectacular sunrise views.
destinations.overview: Narangala is a mountain in Sri Lanka's Uva region known for its distinctive ridge and panoramic views. Its open grassland slopes, which turn golden in the dry months, and elevated summit attract hikers seeking a less commercialised mountain experience.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: It offers dramatic mountain scenery away from Sri Lanka's better-known trekking destinations, with a distinctly local trekking atmosphere.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Travel to Badulla or Bandarawela and continue by local transport towards trail access

experiences.title: Summit sunrise hike
experiences.description: Trek towards the summit before sunrise to experience panoramic views and changing morning light.

photo.file: The Warm Sun Rays falling on Wildflower.png
photo.author: Tharukaprabhashana

experiences.title: Explore the mountain ridge
experiences.description: Explore the ridge and grasslands while enjoying views of valleys and neighbouring ranges.

experiences.title: Walk an Uva tea estate
experiences.description: Walk through a working tea estate in the Uva hills near Badulla and see how the region's well-known tea is grown and processed.

destinations.name: Chitkul
destinations.shortDescription: A remote Himalayan village surrounded by snow-capped peaks, the Baspa River and traditional mountain architecture.
destinations.overview: Chitkul is a village in the Kinnaur district of Himachal Pradesh, near the Indo-Tibetan border. Its traditional wooden homes, mountain scenery and location along the Baspa Valley make it a distinctive Himalayan destination.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Its remote location and slower pace of life make it appealing to travellers looking beyond more commercial Himalayan tourist towns.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Travel to Sangla by road and continue to Chitkul

experiences.title: Walk through Chitkul village
experiences.description: Walk through the village to observe traditional wooden architecture and everyday life.

experiences.title: Baspa riverside walk
experiences.description: Follow accessible riverside areas and enjoy views of the Baspa River and valley.

photo.file: Baspa River flowing next to Chitkul.jpg
photo.author: Sanyam Bahga

experiences.title: Explore the valley trails
experiences.description: Walk up the Baspa Valley beyond the village towards Nagasti, the last outpost before the Indo-Tibetan border, depending on weather.

photo.file: Baspa Valley at Sangla, Himachal Pradesh, India.jpg
photo.author: UnpetitproleX

destinations.name: Lake Khövsgöl
destinations.shortDescription: A vast alpine lake surrounded by forested mountains and remote Mongolian wilderness.
destinations.overview: Lake Khövsgöl is Mongolia's largest freshwater lake and lies near the country's northern border. Its clear waters, taiga forests and mountainous terrain provide opportunities for wildlife observation and outdoor exploration.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: The lake's remote setting offers a sense of wilderness and solitude rarely found at more accessible lakeside destinations.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Fly to Mörön, then travel by road to Khatgal, on the southern shore

experiences.title: Kayak across the lake
experiences.description: Explore the clear waters of Lake Khövsgöl by kayak and enjoy mountain scenery.

experiences.title: Taiga forest exploration
experiences.description: Take a guided walk through forests surrounding the lake.

experiences.title: Stay with a lakeside ger camp
experiences.description: Spend a night in a traditional ger-based camp and experience local hospitality.

destinations.name: Tsingy de Bemaraha
destinations.shortDescription: A surreal limestone forest of sharp pinnacles, narrow passages, suspension bridges and hidden caves.
destinations.overview: Tsingy de Bemaraha National Park protects an extraordinary limestone karst landscape in western Madagascar. Its formations, caves and isolated habitats support distinctive wildlife and guided trekking experiences.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: The difficult access and remote location preserve an adventurous atmosphere and make the landscape feel unlike a conventional nature destination.

travelInfo.bestTime: May–October, especially June–September; the park usually closes in the rainy season (roughly November–April)
travelInfo.gettingThere: Travel from Morondava to Bekopaka using 4x4 transport and river crossings

experiences.title: Grand Tsingy guided circuit
experiences.description: Explore dramatic limestone formations on a guided circuit with elevated passages and bridges.

experiences.title: Petit Tsingy exploration
experiences.description: Experience a shorter guided route through limestone formations, caves and karst landscape.

experiences.title: Manambolo Gorge boat trip
experiences.description: Travel along the Manambolo River through limestone gorges.

destinations.name: Gjirokastër
destinations.shortDescription: A historic hillside town of stone-roofed houses, cobbled streets and traditional Albanian cuisine.
destinations.overview: Gjirokastër is a historic town in southern Albania recognised for its distinctive Ottoman-era architecture and stone-built homes. Its castle, bazaar streets and hillside setting create a layered cultural experience.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: A UNESCO World Heritage town, Gjirokastër sees far fewer visitors than better-known Mediterranean old towns such as Dubrovnik, yet offers an immersive historic atmosphere with artisan traditions, local food and architecture.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Bus or minibus from Tirana or Sarandë

experiences.title: Explore Gjirokastër Castle
experiences.description: Explore the historic castle overlooking the town and discover its architecture and panoramic views.

experiences.title: Walk the old bazaar
experiences.description: Wander through traditional bazaar streets and artisan shops.

experiences.title: Taste Gjirokastër's traditional food
experiences.description: Discover local dishes such as qifqi alongside regional cheeses and specialties.

photo.file: Albanian Meat Pie - Mish me Byrek.jpg
photo.author: Myalbanianfood

destinations.name: Mardin
destinations.shortDescription: A hillside city of honey-coloured stone buildings, ancient religious landmarks and rich culinary traditions.
destinations.overview: Mardin sits on a hillside overlooking the Mesopotamian plains and is known for its distinctive stone architecture. The city reflects a blend of Syriac Christian, Kurdish, Arab and Turkish traditions.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Its location in Türkiye's far southeast, near the Syrian border and well away from the usual Istanbul–Cappadocia–coast route, means few international travellers reach it, so its architecture, crafts and regional food traditions remain largely uncrowded.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Fly to Mardin Airport (MQM), then travel into the old city
travelInfo.language: Turkish, Kurdish, Arabic and other local languages

experiences.title: Walk the old city
experiences.description: Explore narrow streets, historic stone buildings, courtyards and terraces.

photo.file: View from Mardin to the Mesopotamian plains.jpg
photo.author: Florian Koch

experiences.title: Discover historic architecture
experiences.description: Visit historic landmarks such as Zinciriye Medrese.

photo.file: Mardin on roof of Sultan Isa Medresesi 2446.jpg
photo.author: Dosseman

experiences.title: Explore Mardin's culinary traditions
experiences.description: Discover regional dishes such as kaburga dolması (stuffed lamb ribs) and traditional sweets.

photo.file: Syrian Fatteh sold in Mardin, Turkey.jpg
photo.author: Oystercard

destinations.name: Monsaraz
destinations.shortDescription: A whitewashed hilltop village overlooking vineyards, olive groves and the expansive Alqueva reservoir.
destinations.overview: Monsaraz is a medieval hilltop settlement in Portugal's Alentejo region, known for whitewashed houses, historic walls and panoramic views. It overlooks the Alqueva reservoir, part of the Dark Sky Alqueva reserve, one of Europe's best-known stargazing areas.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Its quiet streets, traditional architecture and rural Alentejo atmosphere offer a slower experience of Portugal than busier towns such as Sintra or Óbidos.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Drive from Évora or use regional transport to nearby towns and continue by road

experiences.title: Walk the medieval village
experiences.description: Explore historic streets, castle area and whitewashed buildings.

experiences.title: Stargazing over Alqueva
experiences.description: Watch the night sky over the Alqueva reservoir, part of the Dark Sky Alqueva reserve, with guided stargazing sessions available locally.

experiences.title: Taste Alentejo wine and cuisine
experiences.description: Discover local wine, olive oil and traditional Alentejo dishes.

destinations.name: Shaxi
destinations.shortDescription: A preserved historic market town where ancient trading routes, traditional courtyards and village life remain visible.
destinations.overview: Shaxi is a historic town in Yunnan that once played an important role along regional trade routes associated with the Tea Horse Road. Its old market square and traditional architecture provide a window into regional history.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Shaxi offers a slower alternative to China's popular historic destinations, with a preserved townscape and rural community connections.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Travel via Dali or Jianchuan and continue by road

experiences.title: Explore Sideng market square
experiences.description: Explore the historic market square and traditional buildings.

photo.file: Old Theatre Inn in Shaxi, Nachtansicht.jpg
photo.author: Rod Waddington

experiences.title: Walk the old village lanes
experiences.description: Wander through traditional lanes and courtyards.

experiences.title: Taste Shaxi's local food
experiences.description: Discover local Bai dishes such as rushan (grilled milk-fan cheese) at small restaurants and market stalls.

destinations.name: Fogo
destinations.shortDescription: A volcanic island where dramatic crater landscapes, black lava fields, vineyards and traditional communities coexist.
destinations.overview: Fogo is a volcanic island in Cape Verde dominated by Pico do Fogo. Chã das Caldeiras sits within the volcanic landscape, where residents grow crops and produce distinctive local wine and coffee.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Its volcanic agriculture, isolated communities and strong local identity make Fogo exceptional for landscape and food culture.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Fly to São Filipe Airport (SFL), then travel by road to Chã das Caldeiras

photo.file: Cape Verde Pico do Fogo wide.jpg
photo.author: Cayambe

experiences.title: Climb Pico do Fogo
experiences.description: Take a guided hike towards the volcanic summit and experience crater views.

experiences.title: Explore Chã das Caldeiras
experiences.description: Explore the settlement inside the volcanic caldera and its community.

photo.file: Cape Verde Fogo Chã das Caldeiras school.jpg
photo.author: Cayambe

experiences.title: Taste volcanic wine and coffee
experiences.description: Discover local vineyards, volcanic-grown produce and regional coffee.

photo.file: Vignes et Pico do Fogo à Chã das Caldeiras.jpg
photo.author: F H Mira

destinations.name: Jinan
destinations.shortDescription: China's City of Springs, where historic spring pools, lakeside paths, old streets and Shandong cuisine define the city.
destinations.overview: Jinan, the capital of Shandong Province, is known for its spring-water landscape. Baotu Spring, Black Tiger Spring and Daming Lake are among its best-known landmarks, while traditional streets and local food add to its cultural character.
destinations.whyHiddenGem: Jinan combines spring-fed parks, historic lanes and regional cuisine in a city that can be explored at a relaxed pace, with a distinct local identity beyond China's better-known travel hubs.

travelInfo.gettingThere: Fly into Jinan Yaoqiang International Airport or travel by high-speed rail; city transit links major sights

experiences.title: Visit Baotu Spring and the spring parks
experiences.description: Explore Baotu Spring Park, Wulongtan and nearby spring-water sites to experience the city's defining landscape and traditional gardens.

experiences.title: Walk Qushuiting Street and Daming Lake
experiences.description: Explore old-city lanes, spring-fed waterways and Daming Lake, with time to enjoy the historic neighbourhood atmosphere.

photo.file: Lixia Pavillion, Daming Lake, Jinan in October 2019.jpg
photo.author: HMGiovanniV

experiences.title: Taste Jinan and Shandong cuisine
experiences.description: Discover regional specialties such as youxuan pastries, tianmo savoury porridge and traditional Shandong dishes.
